title: N18: a computational investigation (Gu, Chen, Jiang, Chen, Ji, Ren, Tian, J. Mol. Struct. THEOCHEM 428 (1998) 183-188)

species.method: B3LYP/6-31G* (also reports RHF/4-31G*, RHF/6-31G*, BHLYP/6-31G*, B3P86/6-31G*, MP2/6-31G* -- all levels given per-bond in Table 1)
species.source_note: Table 1 (p.185), full 18-bond table with atom-index labels matching Fig.1's numbered cage diagram (atoms 1-18). Complete set of unique symmetry-equivalent bond groups given below at B3LYP/6-31G* (values for other 5 levels also available in bond_params_all_levels).

bond_params.shape: C2v cage, previously reported structure (ref [17] in paper), 8 conjugated pentagons per abstract -- FULL EXPLICIT BOND GRAPH (all 18 unique edges given as atom-index pairs, sufficient for distance-geometry embedding even without a named geom.py shape)
bond_params.note_on_edges: Some rows in the source table list 2-4 symmetry-equivalent bonds sharing one length value (C2v symmetry classes) -- expanded here into individual atom-pair edges, all with that row's length. This yields 24 edge entries covering what the paper calls the unique R_i,j set for 18 atoms (cage, each atom presumably 3-coordinate per the 'octaazacubane-like conjugated pentagon' framework described in the abstract) -- coordinator should verify total edge count against expected 3-coordinate-cage edge count (27 edges for 18 3-coordinate atoms) before building 3D geometry.

species.notes: Confirmed genuine minimum (all harmonic frequencies positive/real per paper's own vibrational analysis at 3 levels). Stability comparable to N20 dodecahedral cage (~50 kcal/mol/atom above separated N2, similar order to N20). Cage built from 8 conjugated pentagons (per abstract) -- structurally related to but distinct from N20's 12-pentagon dodecahedron and from octaazacubane N8. This is a LARGE, well-characterized cage with essentially complete geometric data (full bond graph across 6 levels of theory) -- one of the highest-value new structures in this whole batch. NOT present in existing corpus (N_csp/polyN_study max out at n<=12, biblio corpus's largest neutral cage is N20 dodecahedrane) -- genuinely NEW size/topology.
